title: CE Interview Data Vocabulary
description: Schema for sidecars/vocabulary.yaml: the ce: custom properties the CE Interview data sidecars use. It checks the file's shape and value forms; what a property means is in the vocabulary itself.

id.description: The vocabulary's identifier, as the master sidecar's ce:vocabulary pointer names it.

version.description: Semantic version, as the master sidecar's ce:vocabulary pointer names it.

properties.description: One entry per ce: property, keyed by its name.

entry.description: One ce: property: where it sits, what it states, its allowed values, and what follows for anyone using the data.

level.description: survey: set once, in the master sidecar. table: set once per table, at schema level in a table sidecar. column: set on a column, in a table sidecar.

text.description: A sentence or more of prose.

values.description: The allowed values, in one of three forms.

closedList.description: The complete list of allowed values: identifiers in lower camel or snake case, or booleans.

typeDescriptor.description: The kind of value, in words: for example 'year', 'text', 'column name', or a structure such as '{id, version}'.

fieldMap.description: A structured value: each field names its type in words, or lists its allowed values.
